problemSigns.detail: Your garage door makes excessive noise as it opens or closes. This indicates worn roller bearings or flat spots.
The garage door moves unevenly or shakes within its tracks. This points to damaged rollers struggling to guide the door.
Inspect your rollers. If you see flat areas on the wheel or the roller wobbles excessively on its stem, replacement is needed.
Moisture exposure, common with older Hoffman Estates doors, can rust roller stems. A bent stem prevents smooth movement.
